say:1:1013706001:1.text: Ah, my friend. You're too good at stealing the limelight.
say:1:1013706001:1.source_cn: 作为战友，你这样的强者令人不快，太会抢风头了。

say:5:1013706005:0.text: Hmph, what a letdown. But... the Sun Temple?

say:6:1013706006:0.text: During this journey, you might encounter the "big guy" before me.
say:6:1013706006:0.source_cn: 那这一路上，说不定你们会比我先碰上“大家伙”呢。

say:13:1013706010:2.text: Shakir, thank you for the information. We'll be cautious.
say:13:1013706010:2.source_cn: 沙奎尔， 多谢你的告知。我们会小心谨慎的。

say:15:1013706011:1.text: No need for thanks. There's a camp ahead where I encountered the big guy once...
say:15:1013706011:1.source_cn: 无需言谢。前方有一处营地，我曾在那里见过大家伙……

say:16:1013706012:1.text: Stay safe until we meet again!
say:16:1013706012:1.source_cn: 你们要保护好自己的性命，直到我们下次再见！
